description:
The marketing team wants a visual 'Shop by Category' section on the homepage. 

Your task is to:
1. Add an Image field named 'Category Image' (machine name: field_category_image) to the 'Product Categories' vocabulary.
2. Upload the provided images from /home/ga/Downloads/category_images/ to the existing terms: 'Headphones', 'Keyboards', and 'Monitors'.
3. Create a new View named 'Category Grid' that displays these terms as a Grid of images and names.
4. Place this View as a block in the 'Content' region of the homepage.

Note: The 'Product Categories' vocabulary and terms already exist.
